We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (template_id 149040) to the molecule given. The molecule is from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-3 answer: a list containing one SMILES: "CCOC(=O)C[C@H]1C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@@H](C)[C@@H](/C=C(/C)C(=O)OC)O1"

So target molecule is that SMILES. We need to apply template 149040 to it, get list of precursor combinations. Use apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles that SMILES and template_id "149040".
